verses.en: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
verses.sm: O le valoaga a Iesu i le faaumatia o le malumalu Ona soo ia te ia, “Le aʻoaʻo e, ina silasila ia i nei maa ua tetele lava, ma nei fale ua tetele lava!”

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.sm: A ua tali atu lesu ia te ia, ua faapea atu, “Ua e iloa ea nei fale tetele? E le tuua le tasi maa i luga o le tasi maa, a e uma lava ona soloia i lalo.”

verses.en: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
verses.sm: Ua nofo o ia i le mauga o Olive, e feagai ma le malumalu, ona fesili lemu lea ia te ia o Peteru, ma Iakopo. ma Ioane, ma Aneterea,

verses.en: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
verses.sm: “Seʻi e taʻu mai ia te i matou, pe fai afea ia mea? Pe se a foi le faailoga pe a lata ona taunuu o ia mea uma?”

verses.en: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, “Ta outou, neʻi faaseseina outou e se tasi;

verses.en: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
verses.sm: aua e toatele e o mai i loʻu nei igoa, ma faapea ane, O aʻu o ia, latou te faaseseina foi tagata e toatele.

verses.en: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
verses.sm: Pe a tou faalogo i taua ma tala o taua, aua tou te atuatuvale; auā e tupu lava ia mea; a e lei oo i le gataaga.

verses.en: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
verses.sm: Auā e sii le taua e le tasi nuu i le tasi nuu, o le tasi malo foi i le tasi malo; e i ai foi mafuie i lea mea ma lea mea, e i ai foi oge; o amataga ia o puapuaga. *

verses.en: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
verses.sm: “Ia outou ia te outou; auā e tuuina atu outou e i latou i fono, ma sasaina outou i sunako; e tutū foi outou i luma o alii ma tupu ona o aʻu, e fai ma molimau ia te i latou.

verses.en: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
verses.sm: to Ia muai tala‘iina foi le tala lelei i nuu uma lava e ao ai. ti Pe a latou taʻ

verses.en: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
verses.sm: itaʻiina ma tuuina atu outou, aua neʻi muai manatu i sa outou e fai atu ai, aua foi le luaʻi fatufatuaʻi; a o se mea e foaiina ia te outou i lena itu aso, O lea tou te fai atu ai; aua e le o outou E fai atu ai, a o le Agaga Paia.

verses.en: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
verses.sm: E tuuina atu foi le uso e le uso ia oti, e tuuina atu foi e le tamā lona atalii, e tutū atu foi le fanau i o latou matua, ina ia fasiotia i latou.

verses.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.sm: E inosia foi outou e tagata urna ona o loʻu igoa; a o lē tumau seia oo i le iuga, e faaolaina lea.

verses.en: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
verses.sm: “Pe a outou iloa le mea e inosia e faatafunaina aʻi, ua fai mai ai e Tanielu le perofeta, ua tu i le mea e le tatau ai, (ina iloa ia e lē faitau), o e o i Iutaia i ia ona po, ia latou sosola i mauga;

verses.en: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
verses.sm: o le ua i luga o le fale, aua neʻi alu ifo ia i le fale, aua foi neʻi ulu ai e ave se mea ai lona fale;

verses.en: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
verses.sm: o le ua i le vao foi, aua neʻi toe foi o ia e ave lona ofu.

verses.en: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.sm: Oi talofa foi i fafine totō, ma E failele i na ona aso!

verses.en: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
verses.sm: A ia outou tatalo ina neʻi sosola outou i le tau maalili;

verses.en: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
verses.sm: auā o ia ona aso E i ai le puapuaga, e leai sona tusa talu lava le amataga o mea na faia e je Atua, ua 00 mai i ona po nei, e le toe faapea foi amuli.

verses.en: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
verses.sm: Afai foi e le faapuupuuina ia aso e le Alii, e leai se tagata e faaolaina; a e peitai ona o le au filifilia ua filifilia e ia ua ia faapuupuuina ai ia aso.

verses.en: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
verses.sm: Afai foi e fa. ane se tasi ia te outou i ia ona po, Faauta, o iinei le Keriso; pe faapea, Faauta, o Wa; aua neʻi faalogo i ai.

verses.en: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
verses.sm: Auā e tutū mai Keriso pepelo, ma perofeta pepelo, ma latou faia faailoga ma vavega, ina ia faasese aʻi e ua filifilia lava, pe afai e mafai ai.

verses.en: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
verses.sm: Ia outou; faauta, ua ou muai ta'uina atu ia te outou ia mea uma.

verses.en: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
verses.sm: “O aso foi ia pe a mavae atu lena puapuaga, e faapogisaina ai le la, e le susulu mai foi le masina,

verses.en: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
verses.sm: e pauu mai fetu o le lagi, e luluina foi “au a le lagi.

verses.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
verses.sm: Ona iloa atu lea e i latou o le Atalii o le ta~ gata ua sau i ao ma le mana tele ma le mamalu.

verses.en: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
verses.sm: Ona aauina mai lea e ia o ana agelu, latou te faapotopotoina e ua filifilia e ia mai matāmatagi e fa; e amata i le tuluʻiga o le lalolagi e oo atu i le tuluʻiga o le lagi.

verses.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
verses.sm: “Ia outou mātau i le faataoto i le mati; pe a faatoa tutupu ona tatupu, ma matala mai ona lau, ona outou iloa ai lea ua latalata mai le tau vevela.

verses.en: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
verses.sm: E faapea foi outou, pe a iloa ia mea ua tutupu mai, ia outou iloa ua latalata mai ia, ua i faitotoa lava.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
verses.sm: E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, E le mavae lenei tupulaga, seia taunuu ia mea uma.

verses.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.sm: E mavae atu le lagi ma le lalolagi; a e peitai aʻu upu, e le mavae lava ia.

verses.en: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
verses.sm: “A o lea aso ma lea itu aso e le iloa e se tasi, e le iloa lava e agelu i le lagi, po o le Atalii; ua na o le Tama lava.

verses.en: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
verses.sm: Ia outou, ina mataala ia, aua tou te le iloa pe 00 mai afea ja aso.

verses.en: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
verses.sm: Faapei o se tagata na alu malaga, na ia tuua lona fale ma avane le pule i ana auauna, ua taitoatasi foi ma lana lava galuega, ma ua fai atu i le leoleo faitotoa ina ia mataala o ia.

verses.en: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
verses.sm: O lea, ia mataala ai outou; aua tou te le iloa poo afea e sau ai le alii o le aiga, po o le afiafi, po o le tautuluaga o le po, po o le vivini o moa, po o le taeao;

verses.en: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
verses.sm: neʻi faafuasei ona sau, e maua mai outou o momoe.

verses.en: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
verses.sm: O le mea ou te fai atu ia te outou, Ou te fai atu ai i tagata uma: Ina mataala ia.”
